canonical_project: Yotta D1 (Greater Noida Data Center Park)
notes: Yotta D1, first of six planned buildings in the ~20-acre Greater Noida Data Center Park (Tusiana, GB Nagar), inaugurated by CM Yogi Adityanath on 2 Nov 2022 as North India's first hyperscale data center; ~5,000 racks, 30 MW IT load (expandable to 50 MW), park cited at 160 MW / up to 250-350 MW across six buildings (30,000 racks).
